transcriptSummary.prose: The Ellettsville Town Council meeting commenced with standard opening procedures, including a prayer, the Pledge of Allegiance, and roll call. A procedural announcement was made regarding the discontinuation of the online chat feature due to changes in Indiana law concerning meeting records. The Council then proceeded to open bids for the Heritage Trail Pedestrian Bridge over Jack Defat Creek. Three bids were received: CLR, Inc. bid $698,890; Crider and Crider bid $737,250; and Fox Construction Company bid $541,363. Following the bid opening, the Council voted to table the bids for review by the planning and street departments. Subsequently, the minutes from the June 9th, 2025 meeting and the accounts payable and payroll vouchers were approved. Two ordinances on second reading received approval: Ordinance 2025-16, which amends zone maps for 30 acres at 444 North Triple Crown Drive from agricultural to R1 single-family residential, and Ordinance 2025-17, amending the zoning map for 5965 North Matthews Drive from R1 single-family residential to R3 multi-family residential for senior housing expansion. Under new business, the Council approved the renewal of the 2025 consulting contract with Rick Copic LLC for a one-year term from July 1, 2025, to July 1, 2026, with a retainer of $750 per month and an hourly rate of $100 thereafter. A motion was also passed to table discussion on the wastewater treatment plant SCADA system electric gates and clarifying louvers until more complete figures were available. Appointments were made, with Andrew Henry appointed to the Redevelopment Commission and Emily Kelly appointed to the Parks Board. During supervisory comments, the Police Chief reported on issues with the fire station roof, noting leaks and delamination, and presented a rough estimate of $150,000 for a full replacement, suggesting financing options and the need for quotes. The initiation of the 2025 budget process was also announced, with plans for an August work session.

documentsSummary.prose: The Ellettsville Town Council convened on July 14, 2025. During the meeting, bids for the Heritage Trail Pedestrian Bridge over Jacks Defeat Creek were publicly opened and subsequently taken under advisement for review, with the winning bid to be announced at a later meeting. The council approved the Accounts Payable Vouchers and Payroll. Two zoning ordinances received approval: Ordinance 2025-16, which rezoned 30 acres at 4444 North Triple Crown Drive from agricultural to R-1 single-family residential, and Ordinance 2025-17, rezoning 5965 N. Matthews Drive from R-1 single-family residential to R-3 multi-family residential for a senior housing expansion. A 2025 consulting contract with COPPCSLT LLC was approved, specifying a $750 monthly retainer and a $100 hourly rate after the retainer is exhausted. A motion concerning the WWTP-SCADA System Electric Gates and Clarifier Louvers was tabled until further figures could be provided. Appointments were made for Andrew Henry to the Redevelopment Commission and Emily Kelley to the Parks Board. Supervisor comments included an update on the Fire Station roof, estimated to cost around $150,000 for repair, with the council agreeing to proceed with obtaining bids. The town manager also noted the commencement of the new budget process.
